items.title: Aaron Nesmith fouls Cooper Flagg chasing him back in transition. Naji Marshall did not take kindly to it and ran right at Nesmith. Small scuffle, broken up by security. Flagg's shoulder seems to be bothering him. Playing being reviewed.
